notes.title: Known game freezing issue
notes.notes:
Unfortunately due to a bug in OpenVR:

https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/issues/391

http://steamcommunity.com/app/358720/discussions/0/133256240733525666/

WiseMind may freeze during Tai Chi exercise due to too many haptic calls, we are working very hard to workaround this issue. Our apology if it causes any inconvenience.
